blockingIssues.description: VAL-CSS-002 remains unmet because `.message-header` is still defined in `packages/extension/sidepanel/styles/chat.css` and still emitted by active sidepanel render paths, so the contract's claim that it is an unused selector is incorrect.

appliedUpdates.description: Documented that `.message-header` is still active and that CSS cleanup work must audit both styles and class emitters before marking selectors as dead.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance for CSS cleanup work to verify both stylesheet definitions and source-side class emitters before a selector is labeled unused in mission plans or validation contracts.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `remove-unused-css-selectors` feature and validation contract listed `.message-header` as dead CSS, but review found active emitters in multiple sidepanel UI renderers and a live stylesheet definition, producing a false-positive blocking failure.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update worker bootstrap/init guidance to invoke `.factory/init.sh` through `bash .factory/init.sh` when the script is not executable.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `consolidate-duplicate-keyframes` review observed `.factory/init.sh` has non-executable permissions in this repo, and the worker only succeeded after switching to `bash .factory/init.sh`.

rejectedObservations.observation: The parent task used the alias `remove-unused-animations` while mission artifacts use `remove-unused-css-animations`.
rejectedObservations.reason: ambiguous naming mismatch for this run only; not strong enough to document as durable repo guidance.

rejectedObservations.observation: The status module still imports `balance-popover` helper code whose DOM ids no longer exist in templates.
rejectedObservations.reason: useful cleanup lead but not yet validated enough for shared guidance during this scrutiny pass.
